full_judgment: 7. The High Court Division observed that the learned Subordinate Judge without going through the evidence has passed the impugned judgment upon his imaginary/assumptive views. The plaintiff  No.1 being out of possession has filed the suit. The finding of the learned Subordinate Judge on possession having been based on no evidence the same is liable to be set aside; that the judgment of the learned Subordinate Judge is not a proper judgment of reversal and is no sustainable in law. The suit being a suit for declaration of title simplicator to 3.30 acre of land out of 7.57 acres of land without any specification is not maintainable.
